notes.title: Small Patch Done!
notes.notes:
Thanks to all of you who helped us have a great game launch!  We've finished our first patch to address a few issues all of you brought up, such as there not being a volume control for Nensu, and an error with the help screen.  Not as many issues as we expected!

We hope you love Oni Onsen.  We truly put our hearts into this game.  While we could have finished sooner, we knew full voice acting would bring this game up to the potential it deserved.  We hope you enjoy it!

Now let's get enough wishlists to make Polyamory!
